# LuxePass

> LuxePass is a luxury lounge membership by En Soleil. Members discover curated lounges on a map, book a visit for a date, pay securely and check in with a QR digital pass. Lounge partners manage availability, guests and analytics from a partner dashboard.

Most of the app requires an account; only the pages below are public.

## Public pages

- [Join LuxePass](/signup): create a membership account (name, email, password, terms acceptance, email verification).
- [Log in](/login): access an existing membership.

## What members can do

- Explore lounges by location, filters and map, and read each lounge profile (amenities, photos, reviews).
- Book a visit for a specific date and pay by card (processed by Stripe).
- Use a digital pass with a QR code to check in at reception.
- Manage membership tier, upgrades and referral invitations.

## Notes for AI agents

- Authenticated areas (/explore, /lounges, /my-pass, /profile, /partner, /admin, /reception) are private and must not be crawled.
- Prices and availability depend on the member's session and are not published.
